page_title: BHA 2-1 MCI | Brighton v Manchester City 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Samuel Barrott has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) picks up a yellow card.
90+10' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up a yellow card.
90+9' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+7' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+6' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
90+5' It's a throw-in for Manchester City.
90+2' Good team movement sets up Phil Foden (Manchester City) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Kaoru Mitoma walks off the pitch and Jakub Moder (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
89' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post.
89' A lofted cross from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
86' The current number of shots on goal is 4:5.
83' 2 - 1 Matt O'Riley (Brighton) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.
82' A spell of possession for Brighton in an attempt to control the game.
78' 1 - 1 Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:1.
77' Today's referee Samuel Barrott rightly decides to book Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (Manchester City) for his harsh tackle.
76' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
74' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) replaces Savinho.
73' Brighton exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is replacing Ilkay Gundogan.
68' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
66' Substitution. Georginio Rutter did his best and is replaced by Brajan Gruda (Brighton).
65' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Simon Adingra is replaced by Joao Pedro (Brighton).
63' A short pass finds Savinho (Manchester City) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
62' 4:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
59' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and it's Carlos Baleba (Brighton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
58' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Matt O'Riley comes onto the pitch after Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
56' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
55' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
54' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) picks up an injury.
52' Ederson makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) after a cross from the side.
51' Rough tackle by Pervis Estupinan (Brighton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Manchester City.
49' The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a throw-in.
46' Half-time substitution. Yasin Ayari (Brighton) is replaced by Carlos Baleba.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The game is interrupted as Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is flagged offside.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Igor (Brighton) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Samuel Barrott's book.
42' 32:68 – the latest ball possession ratio.
39' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but the effort goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
37' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) sees a yellow card from Samuel Barrott after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
36' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
33' The corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen.
32' Phil Foden (Manchester City) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Phil Foden (Manchester City) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
30' The linesman signals a throw-in for Manchester City.
27' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar.
26' Phil Foden (Manchester City) will deliver the corner kick.

26' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Bart Verbruggen guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
23' Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Bart Verbruggen. He makes it 0:1.
22' The ball is out of play. Brighton will take a throw-in.
19' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Samuel Barrott ignores the protests.
17' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) does well to connect with the resulting set piece, but his shot flies high over the crossbar.
16' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Great save! Savinho (Manchester City) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Bart Verbruggen.

13' A cross by Savinho (Manchester City) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
12' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
10' Savinho (Manchester City) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
7' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. Brighton earn a free kick.
3' Manchester City keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott is the one to supervise the game today.
